title: USS Nimitz Suez Canal Transit II
description:
(Nov. 08, 2013) The aircraft carrier USS Nimitz (CVN 68) transits the Suez Canal. Nimitz along with embarked Carrier Strike Group (CSG) 11, Carrier Air Wing 11, and Destroyer Squadron 23, spent nearly three weeks in the U.S. 6th Fleet area of operations conducting exercises with NATO allies and making a port call in Naples, Italy.
US naval convoy crosses Egypt's Suez Canal Al Jazeera English, 8 Nov 2013: "An official at Egypt's Suez Canal says a US aircraft carrier and a destroyer have crossed the waterway from the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea. (...) The official said the aircraft carrier was the USS Nimitz"
